response.sql: WITH cust AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total_spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, total_spent, total_spent * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_spent) FROM cust) AS share FROM cust), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.total_spent) AS avg_total_spent, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_share_diff FROM shares s WHERE s.share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share)
